title: RNA Extraction with Magnetic Beads (no tip waste)
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters in the customization fields: specify the number of samples (must be a multiple of 8 for full columns), set the aspiration height from the bottom of the well for supernatant removal, and define the multi‑channel pipette aspiration flow rate for mixing.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to save the OT‑2 Python script to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and use the “Upload protocol” function to load the downloaded script.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map: place the NEST 96‑well deep‑well plate (2 mL) on the magnetic module, load the 96‑well PCR full‑skirt plate, position the 96‑filter tip rack (200 µL) for the P300 multi‑channel pipette, and add any required reservoirs.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the deck, tip rack, and P300 multi‑channel pipette. Follow the on‑screen prompts to confirm tip‑rack offsets and pipette tip length.

steps.title: Execute the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the RNA extraction protocol on the robot.
